references.note: 3 Sep 1948, page 217. Made 26 Aug 1948. In force: 1 Apr 1949. Confirms Tyrone County Council's order of 15 Dec 1947 extending Dungannon UD.

references.label: Census of Population of Northern Ireland 1951: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas since 1937, Co. Tyrone items (21) and (23) (1 Apr 1949).

references.label: Urban Districts Boundaries (Procedure) Order (Northern Ireland) 1936 (S.R. & O. 1936 No. 170)
references.note: Made 9 Dec 1936 by the Ministry of Home Affairs under section 24 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1934: the local inquiry and public notices required before a county council could make an order altering or defining the boundary of an urban county district. The Dungannon Urban District (Alteration) Order, 1948 recites compliance with it (Belfast Gazette, issue 1419, 3 Sep 1948).
